sentences.en: Induction cookers use magnets to directly heat pots and pans.
sentences.zh: 电磁炉利用磁铁直接加热锅和 pan。

sentences.en: The rock star's induction into the Hall of Fame was predicted by all.
sentences.zh: 这位摇滚明星被纳入名人堂是大家预料之中的事。

sentences.en: I broke my gas-powered rice cooker so I got an induction rice cooker instead.
sentences.zh: 我摔坏了燃气电饭煲，所以换了一个电磁感应的电饭煲。
